title: Crispy-Edge Fried {p} with {v}
steps: Heat a generous spoonful of oil or butter in a skillet over medium-high heat until it shimmers. Slip the {p} in, then turn the heat down to low right away.
Tilt the pan and spoon the hot oil over the whites near the yolks. Cook 2 to 3 minutes, until the whites are opaque with golden, crisp edges.
For the safest finish, keep cooking until the yolks are firm: the target is {doneness}. A runny yolk is your choice and carries more risk.
Season with the {spice}, set the {p} on the {s} with the {v}, and add the {sauce}.
tip: Pile on the greens and use one slice of toast for a light breakfast plate.
